# 0x822A1E80 does `r31 = r3 + 0x80` and writes its three basis rows at
# r31+0x10/+0x20/+0x30. Its caller 0x822A23D8 does `mr r3,r31` before the call
# and `stvx128 v0,r31,r11` with r11 = 192 after building a vector -- so the
# vector lands at r31+0xC0, which is transform+0x40, the SAME block.
# The whole 460-instruction stream of 0x822A23D8 is qualified against XenonRecomp
# at 460/460 (tools/audit_recomp_vs_ghidra_listing.py), with two known
# vpermwi128-immediate defects classified rather than equated. `.pdata` declares
# 460 and the listing is complete -- which matters, because CLAUDE.md records
# that `exports/` recovers 6 instructions of this function.
